name: 雪豆丁
evolution: 雪豆丁 → 雪蛮人 Lv.28 → 雪巨人 Lv.40
description: 出生后被父母放置在雪窝里，进食补充的能量会在冬眠时令身躯快速成长。大手大脚的雪豆丁习惯于翻滚着移动。思维直接，比较容易发脾气，可以抚摸脑袋令其冷静。
descriptionEn: After birth, they are placed by their parents in a snow nest; the energy gained from eating makes their body grow rapidly during hibernation. The big-handed, big-footed Xuedouding is used to moving by rolling. They think straightforwardly and get angry easily; stroking their head can calm them down.

skills.name: 冰锥
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 霜天
skills.description: 敌方获得1层冻结，且每有1层冻结获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 1 layer of Freeze, and gains +1 energy cost to all skills for each layer of Freeze.

skills.name: 丢冰块
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得速度-30。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains Speed -30.

skills.name: 雪替身
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：回复能量，回复值等于被应对技能能耗的2倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; against attacks: restores energy equal to twice the energy cost of the responded skill.

skills.name: 暴风雪
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得1层冻结。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains 1 layer of Freeze.

skills.name: 冰晶坠
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains +1 energy cost to all skills.

skills.name: 冰墙
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：敌方获得2层冻结。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; against attacks: enemy gains 2 layers of Freeze.

skills.name: 冰雹
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外使敌方获得全技能能耗+3。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when responding to a status: additionally makes the enemy gain +3 energy cost to all skills.

skills.name: 冰蛋壳
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：敌方获得2层减速印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; against attacks: enemy gains 2 layers of Slow mark.

skills.name: 冰天雪地
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：被应对技能能耗+3。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; against attacks: the responded skill gains +3 energy cost.
